d: The port of Aulide, enclosed by the ships, and the tents of the Greeks, all illuminated by night to the military structure. Other ships in the distant sea with sails deployed, coming to the port, also illuminated. Teukro with Greek followers.
Achilles, Teucro, and follow-up of Greeks, and Tessali.
Elisena landed with followers of other Greeks, and Teucro.
Courtyard in front of the palace of Aulide. Agamemnon, Arcade.
Walking of vegetables in the royal garden. Iphigenia, and Elisena.
Agamemnon, and Clitenstra, from various parts.
Sacred wood of Diana. Teucro with Soldiers.
Ulysses with Warriors, Clitenstra, Ifigenia, and Elisena.
Achilles with Séguito, and these above.
Piazza d'Aulide with great temple façade. Ships far away. Elisena, and Teukro.
Agamemnon, Ifigenia, Achilles, followed by Greeks, and the above.
